col1: Momentum sleeve - replaces Bottleneck as the 20% sleeve

Own the 20 large US companies whose shares have risen most over the last 6 months, and get out of any that start to fall. Shares that have risen strongly over 6-12 months tend to keep outperforming for a while ('momentum') - one of the most researched patterns in investing.
